answer: A basket left half finished overnight will dry crooked, so the maker covers her work with a damp cloth. Rattan hazel reed binder stake seal governs the covering: a seal hazel reed binders renew after binding bench hearings. The dune is the first cloth laid, the wander the last before the morning comes, and the haven is the coming, the dawn light on the bench. To fake the covering takes 47 false cloths and 47 false comings.
